description: This is a Java test class for testing the ModuleFileParser component in the openmrs-core project. It contains unit tests and integration tests for parsing module XML files, handling invalid inputs, and verifying module properties.

classes.name: ModuleFileParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the functionality of ModuleFileParser, including parsing valid modules, handling invalid files, and error conditions. Uses Spring's dependency injection and JUnit 5 features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DocumentBuilderFactory and DocumentBuilder before all tests.

methods.name: moduleFileParser_shouldFailCreatingParserFromFileIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that creating a ModuleFileParser with a null file throws an appropriate ModuleException.

methods.name: moduleFileParser_shouldFailCreatingParserFromFileIfNotEndingInOmod
methods.description: Tests that supplying a file with an invalid extension (not .omod) results in an exception.

methods.name: moduleFileParser_shouldFailCreatingParserFromFileIfInputStreamClosed
methods.description: Tests that attempting to create a parser with a closed InputStream throws an exception.

methods.name: parse_shouldParseValidXmlConfigCreatedFromInputStream
methods.description: Verifies that the parser correctly reads and extracts module information from a valid XML configuration.

methods.name: parse_shouldFailIfModuleHasConfigInvalidConfigVersion
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid configuration version in the module's XML triggers an exception with the expected message.

methods.name: parse_shouldParseValidLogicModuleFromFile
methods.description: Checks that a valid logic module file is parsed correctly, verifying key properties.

methods.name: expectModuleExceptionWithTranslatedMessage
methods.description: Helper to verify exceptions contain the translated message for a given key.

methods.name: expectModuleExceptionWithMessage
methods.description: Helper to verify exceptions contain a specific message.

methods.name: writeConfigXmlToFile
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Document into a JAR file entry for testing module packaging.

methods.name: createJarWithConfigXmlEntry
methods.description: Creates a JAR output stream with an entry for the XML config file.

methods.name: writeConfigXmlToJar
methods.description: Writes the serialized XML configuration into the JAR output stream.

methods.name: getByteArray
methods.description: Converts a DOM Document to a byte array using DOMImplementationLS for serialization.
